capabilities: Rewrite rough notes into clean sentences
Fix spelling, grammar, punctuation and capitalisation
Keep bullets, links, tags, code and frontmatter intact
Tidy a selection or the whole note
disambiguation: Not a vault or file organiser; it only rewrites the text of a note or selection.
extras: Sends only the tidied text to api.anthropic.com; the API key is stored in plain text in the plugin's data.json. Available on desktop and mobile.
problem: Quick, shorthand notes often carry spelling and grammar errors that are slow to correct by hand without accidentally rewriting the content.

relations.evidence: text you tidy is sent to api.anthropic.com

summary: Command that sends a note or selection to an AI service and returns it with spelling, grammar, punctuation and capitalisation fixed, keeping the original wording.
